request_payload.title: An open-label Phase I/II clinical trial of pyrimethamine for the treatment of patients affected with chronic GM2 gangliosidosis (Tay-Sachs or Sandhoff variants).

mentions.sentence: Late-onset GM2 gangliosidosis is an autosomal recessive, neurodegenerative, lysosomal storage disease, caused by deficiency of ß-hexosaminidase A (Hex A), resulting from mutations in the HEXA (Tay-Sachs variant) or the HEXB (Sandhoff variant) genes.

candidates.label: HEXA-related disorders (Tay-Sachs disease)
candidates.summary: Deficiency of hexosaminidase A makes GM2 ganglioside build up in nerve cells: infants lose skills and develop seizures and blindness; later-onset forms progress
